newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia share volume at high, most stocks gain.
newsitem.headline: Latvia share volume at high, most stocks gain.

text.p: The Latvian share market boomed on Thursday, reaching an all time high in turnover and registering gains in most stocks.
Total turnover came to 575,797 lats ($1 million), beating Wednesday's trade of 131,855 lats of turnover.
"Investor interest is big. There is buying even in those stocks which are traditionally not seen as attractive," one dealer said.
On the main official list, leading share Unibanka was the most traded at 373,191 lats and the price jumped 15 percent to 3.22 lats.
The secondary market was led by the Daugavpils Chain maker, which also saw its price leap to 1.64 lats from 1.43 on volume of 91,856 lats.
Elsewhere on the secondary market, Roja Fish cannery saw renewed interest and turned over 23,205 lats worth of shares, closing higher at 2.04 lats against 1.78 lats.
Staburadze confectionery of the official list was also among the best traded on volume of 22,588 lats as it ended slightly higher at 2.75 lats from 2.70.
The third official list share Riga Transport Fleet registered activity of 16,114 lats and it closed higher.
Salacgriva 95 fish cannery and the Jekabpils Sugar on the secondary list were among the big gainers.
Salacgriva saw shares worth 10,344 lats change hands and the price jumped to 3.10 lats from 2.70 and Jekabpils turned over 8,129 lats as it also closed higher at 42 santimes from 37 santimes.
Mangali Shipyard turned over 3,715 lats and stayed unchanged while Lode Brick company ended higher at 1.36 lats against 1.29 as it registered activity of 3,492 lats.
